abstract: Bilateral atrophic retinochoroidopathy with choroidal neovascular membrane formation in systemic Langerhans cell histiocytosis; keywords include choroidal neovascular membrane and intraocular involvement.

authors: Julie H Tsai; Farah Galaydh; Steven S T Ching
